name: Fujishiro Kasumi
source:
The housewife who Ryousuke decided to steal. A neat and docile Japanese beauty with long black hair. 

Polite and has a gentle demeanor. When she gets mad she doesn't listen at all. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.ubai.org/ubai_ending/ubai_chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
